digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite / CI workflows
propositions: External integration suite currently exercises only one live provider (Anthropic) despite having first-class support for Bedrock and OpenAI-compatible providers, leaving provider-specific regressions undetectable in CI
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in the CI workflow rather than an ambient default, running live jobs once per credentialed provider with loud skips for missing credentials

Provider override must use REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE pointing to a minimal config file setting only [llm.model_classes], not the deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL, to ensure config deep-merge behavior and dogfood the documented developer override path

Bedrock authentication on GitHub-hosted runners requires OIDC role assumption via aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials to a dedicated scoped IAM role, not EC2 instance role, and must fail loudly when region resolution is absent
Tests pinning provider selection must verify both class-based model resolution and the ambient cfg.model fallback to prevent partial overlays from covertly routing requests to the default provider
Multi-provider matrix execution cost must be measured and cadence decision (per-trigger vs reduced schedule) documented with rationale
